hook_line: TEXAS GOVERNOR-ELECT WILL RESCIND ABBOTT'S H-1B HIRING FREEZE

hook_stat.sub: Abbott's H-1B hiring freeze runs until May 31, 2027

stats.label: Hinojosa takes office; the freeze stays in force until then
Ann Richards, the last Democrat elected governor of Texas before Hinojosa
Deadline for covered institutions to report existing H-1B sponsorships to the Texas Workforce Commission

diaspora_bullets: Affected jobs are at Texas public universities, medical schools and state agencies
Private employers were never covered, and renewals are not treated as new petitions
news_summary: Texas Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa told The Texas Tribune she will rescind Governor Greg Abbott's freeze on new H-1B petitions at state agencies and public universities.
payoff: The freeze stays in force until Hinojosa takes office on January 19; until then, new petitions from Texas public employers still need written commission permission.
